title: rick.json
description: Configuration for the rick terminal coding agent.

level.description: allow = run silently, ask = prompt the user, deny = refuse.

default.description: Fallback for anything not matched below.

bash.description: Glob pattern -> level. The most specific matching pattern wins; each sub-command of a compound line is checked and the strictest level applies.

extends.description: Permission profiles to inherit from, weakest first. Later entries win; this block wins over all of them. Built-ins: readonly, standard, trusted, ci.

tools.description: Tool-name glob -> level. Covers MCP tools and any built-in not named by the coarse fields above. Exact names beat globs.

paths.description: Path glob -> level for file-touching tools. Longer patterns win, and an explicit deny always beats a coarse allow.

hosts.description: Hostname glob -> level for webfetch and websearch.

sandbox.description: Sandbox policy to activate alongside this permission set. Overrides the top-level sandbox block.
Confinement applied to every command the bash tool runs.

mode.description: read-only: no writes, no network. workspace-write: writes confined to the project (default). trusted: resource limits only. off: no confinement.

enforcement.description: auto: use OS confinement when available, else fall back to static analysis. os: refuse to run when the kernel fence is unavailable (use in CI). static: analysis only.

network.description: Allow outbound network access. Forced false in read-only mode.

allow_hosts.description: Host globs reachable when the network is on. Empty means every host.

deny_hosts.description: Host globs blocked even when the network is on.

writable_roots.description: Extra absolute directories commands may write to, on top of the workspace and temp.

readable_roots.description: Restrict reads to these directories. Empty means the whole filesystem is readable.

deny_paths.description: Path globs blocked for both reads and writes.

allow_env.description: Environment variable globs that survive credential scrubbing.

deny_env.description: Environment variable globs to strip on top of the built-in credential patterns.

keep_credentials.description: Disable credential scrubbing. Needed for commands that legitimately push to a remote.

memory_mb.description: Memory cap per process. 0 means no limit.

cpu_seconds.description: CPU time cap across the process tree. 0 means no limit.

processes.description: Maximum concurrent processes in the tree. 0 means no limit.

file_size_mb.description: Largest file a command may create. 0 means no limit.

model.description: Active model as provider/model-id, e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929.

small_model.description: Cheap model used for session titles and context compaction.

context_reserve.description: Tokens held back from the context window before compaction is suggested.

autocompact.description: Warn and offer compaction as the context window fills.

distill_enabled.description: Replace the oldest stable chat prefix with a distilled summary as the context window fills.

distill_model.description: Cheap model used for the background distillation summary. Falls back to small_model, then model.

distill_threshold_percent.description: Share of the context window at which the oldest stable prefix folds into a summary (0 = default 55). Per-model policies override this.

distill_retain_ratio.description: Share of the newest history left untouched by distillation (0 = default 0.4). Larger keeps more verbatim context at the cost of a smaller fold.

threshold_percent.description: Fold trigger as a percent of the context window (0 = inherit global).

retain_ratio.description: Share of the newest history kept verbatim (0 = inherit global).

cache_retention.description: Prompt-cache retention for every request: empty (provider default, ~5 min), "long" (extended TTL: Anthropic 1h / OpenAI 24h), or "none" (caching off).

cache_warm.description: When true, submits a small non-blocking request at session start so the provider populates its prompt cache for the frozen system+tools prefix before the first real turn. Lifts cache-hit ratios for short sessions.

cache_warm_turn.description: When true, primes the full provider-facing prefix before every real turn, not just at session start. Providers whose cache evicts mid-session (free flash tiers, short in-memory TTLs) then never pay a full uncached re-bill; costs one cheap non-streaming request per turn, billed at the cached rate when the prefix is still warm.

cache_passback_reasoning.description: When true, drops reasoning_content from tool-call-free turns on DeepSeek-line providers. DeepSeek only requires the previous turn's reasoning echoed back while a tool-call exchange is open; dropping it elsewhere shrinks the fresh tail without rewriting the cached prefix. Defaults to false (keep every reasoning block for a byte-identical append-only prefix).

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Overrides how long a warm prompt prefix is assumed to survive at the provider before an idle gap forces a re-warm (0 = per-vendor table: 1 day for DeepSeek-line endpoints). Set to the real retention when a gateway, e.g. a free flash tier, expires entries in minutes — the idle-gap pre-warm then fires before the next turn instead of paying a full cold re-bill.

cache_keepalive_seconds.description: When positive, keeps the provider prompt cache alive during idle gaps by re-sending the last stream's exact prompt bytes as a minimal request every interval. This holds a near-100% hit rate across long idle on gateways whose cache TTL is minutes, not days. Zero disables.

cache_openrouter_response.description: When true (default), enables OpenRouter's response cache (X-OpenRouter-Cache header) so byte-identical repeated requests — retries, warm, keep-alive, same sub-agent prompt twice — are served from the gateway's response cache at zero billing. Separate from prompt caching and works alongside it.

cache_openrouter_response_ttl.description: Response-cache TTL in seconds sent with X-OpenRouter-Cache-TTL (1-86400). Zero omits the header and uses OpenRouter's default.

cache_max_tool_result_bytes.description: Caps each tool_result payload sent to the model (0 = default 16 KiB). Bounding the per-turn fresh tail keeps the provider prompt-cache hit ratio high on tool-heavy turns.

cache_spill_bytes.description: When positive, tool results larger than this many bytes are spilled to the content-addressed store and the model sees a bounded preview plus a retrieval locator (retrieve_uncompressed_context) instead of the full payload. Keeps the cached prefix small without losing the bytes. 0 disables spilling (truncate in place).

cross_session_memory.description: When true (default), a brand-new session for the same (project, model, agent) loads the previous session's deterministic goal-state snapshot as its leading user message, so the byte-stable prefix (system + tools + snapshot) stays warm across sessions instead of re-priming cold. The snapshot is derived from the transcript — no LLM calls.

cache_strategies.description: Maps a provider id (or provider/model) to a named prompt-cache strategy. Each entry overrides the flat cache knobs for that route: retention, TTL, keep-alive, warm, warm-turn, passback reasoning, reasoning cap, and the divergence reason.

name.description: Strategy name surfaced in telemetry and /stats.

ttl_seconds.description: Assumed warm-prefix lifetime before an idle gap forces a re-warm (0 = inherit global).

keepalive_seconds.description: Prompt-cache keep-alive interval (0 = inherit global, disabled).

warm_turn.description: Prime the full prefix before every real turn.

passback_reasoning.description: DeepSeek reasoning-passback rule: drop reasoning_content from tool-call-free turns.

divergence_reason.description: Override the classified divergence cause for telemetry.

subagent_depth.description: How many levels of subagent spawning are permitted.

provider.description: LLM backends. The key is the name used in model ids.

type.description: Wire protocol. Defaults to the provider key. Unknown types with a baseUrl are treated as OpenAI-compatible.

baseUrl.description: Override the API endpoint (local gateways, proxies).

cache_retention.description: Per-provider override of cache_retention (empty = inherit global).

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Per-provider override of cache_ttl_seconds (0 = inherit global).

cache_keepalive_seconds.description: Per-provider override of cache_keepalive_seconds (0 = inherit global).

cache_warm_turn.description: Per-provider override of cache_warm_turn: prime the full prefix before every real turn.

cache_passback_reasoning.description: Per-provider override of cache_passback_reasoning: drop reasoning_content from tool-call-free turns on DeepSeek-line providers.

permission_profile.description: Reusable named permission sets referenced by permission.extends and by agents. The built-ins (readonly, standard, trusted, ci) are always available and may be overridden here.

sandbox.description: Global command confinement. A permission profile may override it.

tools.description: Enable or disable tools by exact name or glob, e.g. {"mymcp_*": false}.

mcp.description: Model Context Protocol servers. Their tools register as <server>_<tool>.

command.description: Local servers: argv to spawn, communicating over stdio.
Custom slash commands. Also loadable from .rick/commands/*.md.

template.description: Prompt sent to the model. $ARGUMENTS is replaced with the command's arguments.

instructions.description: Extra instruction file globs always included in the system prompt. RICK.md and AGENTS.md are picked up automatically.

tui.description: Presentation settings. Prefer a separate tui.json.

web_search.description: Web search restrictions, logical budget, bounded fallback, and provider health controls.

allow_domains.description: If set, only return results from these domains.

max_searches_per_session.description: Logical Rick searches per session; provider retries do not consume extra units.

logical_budget.description: Preferred name for the logical per-session search budget.

provider.description: auto, parallel, or one explicit provider ID. Bing is intentionally not an automatic option.

providers.description: Only explicitly configured providers are eligible except DuckDuckGo, which is the keyless default.

api_key.description: Prefer api_key_env so secrets remain outside rick.json.

vision.description: Vision bridge: gives a text-only model (DeepSeek) sight by routing image attachments through a vision-capable model and feeding back structured text evidence.

enabled.description: When true, image attachments are sent to the vision model and replaced with text evidence for the text-only model.

api_key.description: Free Google AI Studio key (https://aistudio.google.com). Set with /visionapi.

model.description: Vision model id. Defaults to gemini-3.5-flash-lite (free tier).

base_url.description: Gemini API root. Defaults to https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com
